output.reason: [ev-d0cda25040fe] is listed under Breaking Changes. It says that from v3, `update` or `delete` policies on an application no longer apply to its sub-resources, and that "new policies must be defined" to allow `update/*` or `delete/*` on managed resources. That is access users relied on being lost when the operator does nothing, so permission-lost (mandatory work) is supported. The remediation (new policies, or setting `server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance` to false in argocd-cm) matches the text.
